svg.text: coverloop — real captured session (v2.7.2)
① an unreviewed change tries to pass the gate
$ coverloop gate --min-tier L2 --require-transcript
coverloop gate — commit 174caffefd9e — tier L2
✘ tests tests: NO RECORD — run `coverloop attest --tests`
✘ codex codex: NO RECORD — independent diff review is mandatory at L2/L3
VERDICT: FAIL — required evidence missing or failing
exit 1 → merge blocked
② so the loop runs for real — tests + a cross-vendor review, captured & hashed
$ coverloop attest --tests --codex pass \
--codex-run "codex exec -m gpt-5.6-sol -c model_reasoning_effort=\"high\" --sandbox read-only '…'"
running tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests Ran 81 tests … OK
capturing codex reviewer: codex exec -m gpt-5.6-sol … CLEAN (46,723 tokens)
recorded [tests=pass, codex=pass[captured]] -> .coverloop/reports/174caffe….json
commit this report with your change — it is the PR-visible evidence.
③ the same command — now the change has earned its merge
$ coverloop gate --min-tier L2 --require-transcript
coverloop gate — commit 174caffefd9e — tier L2
✔ tests tests: pass (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests)
✔ codex codex: pass, open findings: 0 [captured c5ba04dc]
VERDICT: PASS
exit 0 → merge allowed
